adaptation: Uniform vector constructor plus unchanged pow lane body; one FP32 exponent is shared by all lanes. This is the vector primitive, not a claim about the public ATen pow scalar-dispatch fast paths. The cuDNN graph is mechanically emitted from the raised reference. cuDNN opcode semantics are trusted and separately tested; no proprietary cuDNN source is imported.
